name: year
description: Reference year, at 30 June for the population and the financial year ending 30 June for the components

name: sa2_id
description: Code of the Statistical Area Level 2
observations: The entire series is published on the ASGS Edition 3 (2021) boundaries: ABS restates history onto current boundaries at each release, so codes are comparable across every year of this table but NOT against figures published in releases before the 2021 edition, which used ASGS 2016. Use br_bd_diretorios_au.correspondence_sa2_2016_2021 to bridge that break

name: sa2_name
description: Name of the Statistical Area Level 2

name: sa3_id
description: Code of the Statistical Area Level 3 containing the SA2

name: sa4_id
description: Code of the Statistical Area Level 4 containing the SA2

name: gccsa_id
description: Code of the Greater Capital City Statistical Area containing the SA2

name: state_id
description: Code of the Australian state or territory containing the SA2

name: births
description: Number of births registered to usual residents of the area during the financial year
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: deaths
description: Number of deaths of usual residents of the area during the financial year
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: natural_increase
description: Births less deaths during the financial year
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: internal_arrivals
description: Number of people who moved into the area from elsewhere in Australia
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: internal_departures
description: Number of people who moved out of the area to elsewhere in Australia
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: net_internal_migration
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: overseas_arrivals
description: Number of people who moved into the area from overseas
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: overseas_departures
description: Number of people who moved out of the area to overseas
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: net_overseas_migration
observations: Published by ABS only for the four most recent financial years, so this column is null for earlier years of the ERP series

name: area_sqkm
description: Area of the region in square kilometres
observations: Published with the latest release only and carried across every year, because it is a property of the boundary and the whole series is published on a single boundary vintage

name: population_density
description: Estimated resident population per square kilometre, as published by the ABS
observations: Populated only for the latest reference year, the one year ABS publishes it for. It is deliberately not recomputed for earlier years: ABS derives density from the unrounded area while publishing area rounded to 0.1 km2, so erp / area_sqkm reproduced only 35% of SA2 values within 0.1 and erred by up to 2769
